Detailed Description

File descriptor implementation. This class is basically a wrapper around an int fd that automatically closes the descriptor on destructor and prevents from having multiple copies of the file descriptor to avoid programming errors.

This class will be aggregated by all classes modeling OS resources implementing the file descriptor interface.

Gets file descriptor.

File descriptor can be used for example in:

  • select(), poll() or epoll() to wait for events on this descriptor.
  • send() family of functions to send data through the socket connection.
  • recv() family of functions to receive data from the socket connection.
